cards.title: Overhead maneuver, RWY {to.runway}
instructions: Offset ¼ WTD from the runway centerline toward the pattern side ({to.runway.patternSide} traffic)
Tower may instead specify a straight-in, downwind or base entry
cards.note: Normal entry is from the initial to an overhead maneuver. The break point and landing-checklist timing are not written in the sources used here. Check with an instructor.
cards.source: Binder, p. 3; Manual 3710.14, p. 3-38; CR2025 summary of changes.
